ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious DLL Loaded via CertOC.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when a user installs certificates by using CertOC.exe to load the target DLL file.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\certoc\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "CertOC\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-LoadDLL\\ .*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Appdata\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Desktop\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Downloads\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Tasks\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*")))
